## Definition of Done

- [ ] Branch named `feature/<issue#>-...` or `fix/<issue#>-...`; PR is small and focused
- [ ] CI is green (build, tests, Checkstyle/Spotless, ESLint/Prettier)
- [ ] Business logic has unit tests; money uses BigDecimal, 2 decimals
- [ ] UI matches Figma at 320 / 768 / 1200 and works with the keyboard
- [ ] API changes are in Swagger; README updated if setup changed
- [ ] At least 1 approval (Team Lead or another developer) before squash merge
- [ ] After merge: move the issue to **Ready for Test**
